label: Telemetry Stream
description: One sample per service per metric per minute. Noise is the default; the thresholds decide what is signal.
governanceNote: Recording every sample as an alert buries the one that matters.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Watchtower (2026-09-30).

label: Alert Thresholds
description: Per service and metric: the limit, and the impact and scope a crossing implies. Versioned, because incidents edit them.
governanceNote: Too low burns humans; too high burns customers. The postmortem loop re-decides it with evidence.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Watchtower (2026-09-30).

label: Alert Event
description: A threshold crossing captured as a record: what, how much, against which limit, when.
soloRebuildPath: Compare each sample with its limit
governanceNote: Every crossing is recorded even when it is deduplicated for paging.
auditNote: Authored for the runnable-flow build of Watchtower (2026-09-30).

label: Dedup Window
description: One incident, not forty alerts: a crossing for a service and metric with an open incident joins it.

label: Severity Matrix
